closureRule: No decision may be marked CLOSED_WITH_EVIDENCE unless the written external decision or independent-test evidence exists, its assumptions are captured, required follow-up execution is complete where applicable, and the relevant G1 Closing Board control is updated without overclaiming broader closure.
